reviews.evidence: Corpus search found no canonical Schrödinger representation knowl; existing callers only described the model inline or named it without a target. Added the standard translation-modulation formula on L²(Rⁿ), with q as the modulation coordinate and p as the translation coordinate. Direct composition gives the phase exp(-i B/2) for B((q,p),(q',p'))=q·p'-p·q', matching shale-paper/weyl-ccr-quantization. The core contains only the representation and Weyl relation; operator generators, continuity, uniqueness, and normalization evidence are expandable. Checked Folland, Harmonic Analysis in Phase Space, Chapter 1 §1.2 (electronic edition DOI 10.1515/9781400882427). Root re-read source and Lp-space/unitary-operator targets: added exact defining body links and measure specification, moved the derived Weyl identity after the core; checked phase directly as (q-prime dot p minus q dot p-prime)/2. Removed fictitious legacy source path.
reviews.reference_check: Root checked publisher-supplied preview table of contents: Folland Chapter 1 §3 begins p.21, not §2. Phase normalization verified by the explicit multiplication in this knowl; preview is bibliographic verification, not evidence of checking the full section.

lessons: A repeated inline model becomes a missing canonical definition when it has a convention-sensitive Weyl phase that callers need to reference.
